summary: The keystone bundle establishes a structurally defensible compliance posture across the 14+ regimes in scope (GDPR, KR-PIPA, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP Moderate/High, EU AI Act, EU NIS2, EU DSA, JP APPI, SG PDPA, KSA NDMO/PDPL, DoD IL5/6, COPPA, KOSA, plus EU ePrivacy, UK GDPR/AADC, LGPD, CCPA/CPRA, DPDPA, AU Privacy Act, Quebec Law 25, CH revFADP, and ISO 27001/27701/22301/42001/SOC2). ADR-0251 is the keystone compliance-pack primitive that binds all other regimes through the pack registry; ADR-0272 (cookie consent), ADR-0273 (email auth), ADR-0276 (GDPR Article 20 portability), and ADR-0292 (minor-user/COPPA/KOSA) are tight regime-specific overlays that compose cleanly onto ADR-0251. ADR-0240/0241 provide the sovereign-cloud and DR/BC substrate that satisfies the operational-evidence requirements of CSAP, K-ISMS-P, GAIA-X, NDMO, FedRAMP, and ISO 22301. Notable strengths: per-jurisdiction overlay matrix with strictest-wins semantics; verifiable parental consent state machine; dual-signature (Ed25519 + cosign) attestation for portability; per-tenant DKIM/SPF/DMARC isolation preventing reputation cross-contamination; per-microservice audit emission convention. Findings: NIS2 cybersecurity-incident notification cadence is underspecified relative to its 24-hour early-warning requirement; ePrivacy Regulation 2024 draft is treated as soft anchor but its ratification path could shift before substrate ships; DSA Article 16 notice-and-action and Article 24 transparency-report cadence are not wired into ADR-0251's regulator_evidence_cadence enum; APPI cross-border transfer (Article 28) lacks an explicit consent-record schema parallel to GDPR SCC; KSA NDMO data-classification taxonomy (Open/Public/Restricted/Confidential/Top-Secret) is not explicitly mapped to the data-class-registry; COPPA Safe Harbor enrollment (kidSAFE/Privo) is mentioned as out-of-scope but should have a binding decision point; FERPA 60-day audit-cure window is in the cert-level matrix but lacks dedicated workflow; PCI DSS 4.0.1 QSA scope-confirmation cadence is missing from the install workflow; IL5/IL6 cleared-personnel attestation cadence underspecified; cookie-consent IAB TCF v2.2 forward-compat seam may collide with EU APD Belgium 2022 ruling that TCF strings are themselves PII. Overall the bundle is APPROVE for synthesis: gaps are addressable through follow-up overlay ADRs without restructuring the keystone primitive.

recommendations: MERGE the bundle. The 7 ADRs are structurally coherent and compose cleanly: ADR-0251 is the keystone pack primitive; ADR-0272/0273/0276/0292 are tight regime-specific overlays; ADR-0240/0241 are the operational substrate. Partial acceptance is correctly rejected by the bundle design.

overall_signal_for_synthesizer.synthesizer_guidance: F13-Compliance signals APPROVE for the bundle merge. The bundle correctly identifies regulation-as-bundle as the canonical primitive and binds 38+ regimes to the same pack lifecycle.
